hints.title: Sort Edges by Activation Timestamp
hints.text: Sort the network links in ascending order of their appearance timestamps.

hints.title: Merge Components Incrementally
hints.text: Process each edge in order, connecting disjoint components and decreasing the component count.

hints.title: Target Component Threshold
hints.text: Return the timestamp of the edge that reduces the connected component count to at most k.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Kruskal-like edge processing with disjoint set union until component target is reached.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing connected components from scratch after each timestamp takes O(E * (V + E)).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Disjoint set union processes edges incrementally in near-linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sort edges by timestamp and maintain component count using union find.
